case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You wrote that you are eager to prove yourselves as a long-term partner, and Option A is where that starts: a firm quality commitment that you can stand behind from the first delivery.

Option A is the package we can approve. It ties your price to a tighter quality commitment, and the claims below show why the offer on the table has to move.

On quality:
Your quality was 2376 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

On energy costs:
German electricity producer prices changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 39.85.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.18.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.41.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our Angebot stands at a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We can do the 1500 ppm you want in Option A, no problem. To make Option A work, we need 46.00 EUR so we can keep things running smoothly. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €46.00 per unit, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You said you cannot give up margin right now, and Option A is built around that: you commit to the quality you already offered, and in return you get a clear, workable chargeback structure.

You offered a firm quality commitment, and the options below turn it into a clean trade. A lower chargeback goes with a better price, and the three options let you pick the balance that suits you.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 150.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.52.
Option B: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.48.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 300.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.57.

Option A is the package we can approve. It rests on the quality commitment you put in writing yourselves, and it gives you a defined, moderate chargeback rather than an open-ended one.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our current Angebot is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. 

As an alternative, we can do Option A with the 150 EUR chargeback, but the price has to be 46.50 EUR. This package offers a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint. 

Can you send over the numbers showing how you came up with that 150 EUR chargeback? Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. If you can pay us faster, that would really help us out and maybe we can do more on the price. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
